workDigest.title: Work digest
workDigest.description: One person's daily digest of what is waiting on them. Written only when their queue is not empty, so a row here means a message went out and the absence of a row means nothing was said (one-personal-queue).

person.title: Person
person.description: Nextcloud user id of the person the digest is for

waiting.title: Waiting
waiting.description: How many things were waiting on this person when the digest was composed

late.title: Late
late.description: How many of those were already past their date

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: The first few items by name, so the message says something concrete

subject.nl: {{waiting}} dingen wachten op je, waarvan {{late}} te laat
subject.en: {{waiting}} things are waiting on you, {{late}} of them late

queueMention.title: Mention on the queue
queueMention.description: A record that one person was named in a note, so the mention can be waited on rather than only rung. Closes when the reader opens what they were mentioned in; it is never dismissed (one-personal-queue).

person.title: Person
person.description: Nextcloud user id of the person who was mentioned

actor.title: Mentioned by
actor.description: Nextcloud user id of the person who wrote the note

subjectType.title: Subject type
subjectType.description: What the note was written on, usually a case

subjectId.title: Subject
subjectId.description: Identifier of the object the note was written on

noteId.title: Note
noteId.description: Identifier of the note carrying the mention

acknowledgedAt.title: Acknowledged at
acknowledgedAt.description: When the reader opened what they were mentioned in; empty while the mention is still waiting
